specification.problem: Quantized density classification of a 5-bit input x: decide majority 0 vs majority 1 using a single quantum particle (QPA) whose position basis has 32 states indexed by x. A unitary U (parameter theta plus others, found offline by a genetic algorithm) is applied T times, then position is measured and the mass in a boundary partition P decides the output.
specification.reconstruction_scope: One tiny explicit instance: n=5, one particle on a 32-site ring (5 position qubits) with one optional coin qubit (6 qubits total). The input is loaded as the initial basis state |x>. U = S*(I tensor Ry(2 theta)) is applied T times, then the position register is measured and the P-mass is thresholded at 1/2. Classical GA search is described only as an objective. Outside scope: the actual GA-found unitaries, partitions, theta values, the paper's exact QPA Hamiltonian/operator form, and generalization to arbitrary n.

symbols.meaning: binary input string, also the integer index of the initial position
symbols.domain: x in {0,...,31}, bit i of x on qubit i (little-endian)

symbols.meaning: coin/mass rotation angle; small gives light, fast particle, large gives heavy, slow particle
coin-controlled shift: +1 mod 32 if coin=0, -1 mod 32 if coin=1
symbols.domain: unitary on coin and position registers

symbols.meaning: boundary partition: set of position basis states labelled majority-1
symbols.domain: subset of {0,...,31}, encoded as a 32-bit mask

symbols.meaning: probability of measuring position j for input x after T steps
GA fitness: mean correct-side probability over all inputs

equations.label: Initial state
equations.description: Input encoded as starting position by X gates on qubits with x_i=1; coin starts in |0> (assumed).
equations.justification: Sketch places the particle at |x>; the coin initial state is a choice.

equations.label: One-step evolution
equations.latex: U=S\,(C(\theta)\otimes I),\quad C(\theta)=R_y(2\theta),\quad S=|0\rangle\langle0|\otimes V+|1\rangle\langle1|\otimes V^{\dagger},\ V|j\rangle=|j+1 \bmod 32\rangle
equations.description: Dirac-like discrete walk with coin; theta sets the effective mass.
equations.justification: The abstract says a unitary operator with parameter theta drives evolution, with small theta giving small mass and fast evolution; the specific coin-shift form is a proposed construction, and the paper's operator may differ.
assumptions: Coin-shift form is a stand-in for the paper's operator
GA may add extra Ry/Rz/CX layers

equations.label: State after T steps and output probabilities
equations.description: Measuring only position qubits marginalizes over the coin.
equations.abstract_quote: when the particle was measured, it was more likely to collapse to the basis states that were on the correct side of the boundary partition
equations.justification: Measurement probabilities of the evolved state determine the correct-side likelihood.

equations.label: Decision rule
equations.description: Majority 1 if the measured mass in P exceeds 1/2; no ties since n=5 is odd.
equations.abstract_quote: the QPA to decide if the binary input had majority density 0 or majority density 1
equations.justification: Abstract states a boundary partition makes the classification decision; the 1/2 threshold is the natural choice.

equations.label: GA fitness
equations.description: Mean probability on the correct side of P over all 32 inputs; the chromosome is (theta, other angles, 32-bit mask).
equations.justification: Proposed formalization of the GA objective; the abstract only says the GA searched for unitaries and partitions.

registers.name: c
registers.role: classical bits for the position measurement

specification.initial_state: Coin |0>, position |x> via X gates on qubits where x_i=1.

steps.description: Load x by X gates on position qubit i where x_i=1.
Apply U T times: Ry(2 theta) on coin, then coin-controlled increment/decrement on the position register built from MCX/standard gates; the GA-found angles are inserted as fixed constants.
Measure the position qubits only; reverse the counts key to read the index j (last char = bit 0).
Sum counts over j in P and compare to half the shots.
Offline: GA tunes theta, other angles, and P by maximizing F.

specification.measurement: Measure the 5 position qubits into 5 classical bits; the coin is not measured.
specification.classical_postprocessing: Reverse the Qiskit key to get j, sum probability over P, output 1 if above 1/2 else 0.
assumptions: n=5 with the input indexing one of 32 basis states
Coin-shift walk form is an assumption
T, theta, and P are not given in the abstract and must be supplied by a GA run
missing_information: Exact QPA unitary form and parameterization
Values of theta, T, and P found by the GA
Whether the paper uses a coin or a different internal degree of freedom
